title: THE END OF THE WORLD
lyrics_synced:
[00:11.78] Why does the sun go on shining?
[00:19.66] Why does the sea rush to shore?
[00:27.55] Don't they know it's the end of the world?
[00:35.05] 'Cause you don't love me any more.
[00:43.29] Why do the birds go on singing?
[00:51.18] Why do the stars glow above?
[00:59.03] Don't they know it's the end of the world?
[01:06.55] It ended when I lost your love.
[01:14.44] I wake up in the morning and I wonder.
[01:22.31] Why everything's the same as it was.
[01:30.14] I can't understand, no, I can't understand,
[01:38.02] How life goes on the way it does.
[01:46.27] Why does my heart go on beating?
[01:54.13] Why do these eyes of mine cry?
[02:01.96] Don't they know it's the end of the world?
[02:09.50] It ended when you said goodbye.
[02:17.70] (Why does my heart go on beating?)
[02:25.57] (Why do these eyes of mine cry?)
[02:33.45] Don't they know it's the end of the world?
[02:40.88] It ended when you said goodbye.
